tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The principal behind the token, the grant it rides on, and its scopes and limits.

tools.name: my_grants
tools.description: Every grant the principal gave, per app, with children delegated to agents.

tools.name: my_entitlements
tools.description: Every product the principal holds, with pay, cancel, manage and promote links filled in, and which apps honour each.

tools.name: delegate_grant
tools.description: Hand a narrower grant to an agent: a subset of this token's scopes, limits no larger, an expiry no later. Answers a refresh token for the agent, shown once.

tools.name: revoke_grant
tools.description: Revoke one of the principal's grants and every child delegated from it. The app hears at once.

tools.name: cancel_entitlement
tools.description: Ask the seller to cancel. The standing stays until the seller reports the cancellation; the seller's cancel link comes back too.

tools.name: check_entitlement
tools.description: Does the principal hold this product in good standing.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: The apps this hub knows: their scopes, what they sell, what they honour.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: One app in full: its descriptor as the hub last read it.

tools.name: register_app
tools.description: Register an app by any URL on its origin. The hub reads /.well-known/openaccess.json there and lists what it found.
